top_signals.title: Supreme Court again rejects Trump bid to overturn E. Jean Carroll verdict
top_signals.summary: President Trump was held civilly liable in the case by a New York federal jury for defaming and sexually abusing the writer E. Jean Carroll.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Nearly 750k had financial info, SSNs leaked in South Carolina loan company breach
top_signals.summary: The breach affected anyone who received a loan through the company or inquired about a loan product through a third party.
